# Authority Risk Oracle

> Can one person move this protocol's funds? Scores for 197 contracts on 9 oracles: how many keys it takes to act, and how long anyone has to react. A read-only watch re-reads everything every 6 hours and publishes plain files.

## Start here

- [Catalogue of every published file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/watch-data/catalog.json): where each file is, what it holds, its schema, and which one answers which question
- [Reference for every field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/watch-data/API.md): the meaning of every file and every key of the contract pages
- [One contract as JSON](https://realspap.github.io/oracle/p/{chain}-{address}.json): score, sub-scores, the independent read of the admin, held assets, pause, roles, admin Safe activity
- [Dashboard](https://realspap.github.io/oracle/): the same data for people, with filters and a live check per row
- [One contract's dossier in one command](https://github.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/blob/main/scripts/dossier.py): python3 scripts/dossier.py <chain> <address>, from a clone, no network, unread sources said as such
- [Ask a question of all contracts](https://github.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/blob/main/scripts/find.py): python3 scripts/find.py --kind eoa --min-money 1e8, from a clone, no network; a field the watch did not read excludes the row and is counted
- [A protocol's brief in one command](https://github.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/blob/main/scripts/brief.py): python3 scripts/brief.py morpho-blue, one page on every chain it is tracked on; a headline never rests on a value the watch did not read
- [Replay the tests' own checks](https://github.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/blob/main/scripts/mutate.py): python3 scripts/mutate.py breaks the code one way at a time and says whether the suite notices; a mutant that does not run is never counted as caught

## Questions and the file that answers them

- Who controls this contract, and how many keys does it take to act? [second_opinion.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/second_opinion.json): results[] where chain and target match: kind, holder, threshold, keys_to_act, delay_seconds
- Which contracts put the most money behind the fewest keys? [second_opinion.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/second_opinion.json): exposure[]: keys_to_move, react_hours, money_per_key_usd
- Which contracts share an admin, and how much money is behind it? [second_opinion.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/second_opinion.json): clusters[]
- What is firing right now? [alerts.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/alerts.json): active[]: rule, severity, chain, target, first_seen
- Is anything paused? [pause_state.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/pause_state.json): paused[] (chain:target keys); changes[] for a flip since the previous run
- What is queued against a contract, and when does it execute? [pending_ops.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/pending_ops.json): results[].pending[]: ready_at (or eta on a Compound-style timelock), signature, state (or still_queued)
- Did an admin Safe that was idle just execute? [safe_activity.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/safe_activity.json): woke[]; changes[] with delta and idle_days
- Is the Watch running and healthy? [status.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/status.json): state (ok / degraded / alarm) and reasons[]; metrics.prom: aro_run_timestamp_seconds
- Has any published file been altered after the run? [signature.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/signature.json): manifest.files{path: sha256} and manifest.events_chain_head; at the top level signed, public_key, signature; verify: python3 scripts/sign_run.py --watch watch --verify
- What moved since the previous run? [latest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/main/watch/latest.json): movers[], alerts[], unread[]

## Integrity

- [Signed manifest of every run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/watch-data/signature.json): sha256 of each published file and the head of the hash-chained event log; check it with scripts/sign_run.py --verify
- [Event log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealSpap/authority-risk-oracle-showcase/watch-data/events.jsonl): one line per score move or finding, each line commits to the previous one

## Limits

- A score is the oracle's reading of who can act and how fast. The independent read is a separate reader that shares nothing with the scorer; where they differ the file says so.
- A value that could not be read is absent or marked stale, never zero.
- Scores are not investment advice.
